row.body: The map's route ends at a chalk line. A keyring rests across the fold back toward the starting point; its tag has no place name.
row.title: The lap with no return mark

sidecar.gloss: A route stops before its return and a key has no destination.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field crew could mark a temporary route and leave its gate key there; a missing place name does not prove an evacuation failed.

row.body: the black umbrella bears a treated-seed stain and the camera a closure mark. one rope knot holds both objects together.
row.title: two traces on the black umbrella

sidecar.gloss: Farm residue and response markings share one deliberately ambiguous bundle.
sidecar.rival_reading: The farm program and the emergency response each explain one layer of the bundle, and the shared knot does not establish which purpose came first.

row.body: A clear ring dries across the notebook's crop-row drawing. The bottle cap is clean; the page beneath it is stained only where the drawn rows meet.
row.title: The bottle's ring crosses a row sketch

sidecar.gloss: A water mark crosses a field sketch without showing its source.
sidecar.rival_reading: A response worker could record field conditions while checking a route; the ring and sketch do not establish that a program spread anything.

row.body: “Track access ends at the barrier. Keep the west lane clear for the last vehicle.” The receiving line is blank; on the back, someone asks for a green scarf to be saved.
row.title: Dispatch copy with an unfinished return

sidecar.gloss: A dispatch copy closes a route but records no receiver.
sidecar.rival_reading: A work crew could close its course and leave a receipt incomplete; the blank line does not show whether the order came from emergency response or a test.

row.body: The note lists three crop rows and a water check, then continues onto the cover. “Bring the small boots home” is written below the last line.
row.title: The row count continues past the page

sidecar.gloss: A field count and a private reminder share one page.
sidecar.rival_reading: A responder could record conditions beside a closed route and leave a family reminder; the crop count does not prove a program malfunction.
